# 🌙 The World After My Rebirth Is Far Too Tempting — Patch Notes
The lift runs straight, a bar of chitin is a material, and the Riftmaw has no favorites.
Hotfix from User Feedback
LARGE RIFTMAW UPDATE - A Map of its Own!
Riftmaw Location Fix
*The Riftmaw stops throwing you back up the stairs.*
Dungeons stop helping. If you want something from the dark, you pay for it.
Monsters fight like they mean it, your defense always gets its roll, and rivals stop repeating one line.
Riftmaw Remake + MUCH MORE! (1/2)
Riftmaw Remake + MUCH MORE! (2/2)
Rolls that make sense, failures that mean something, rewards you can point to, and a new race.
A deep start that finally lets you climb, and a top-to-bottom quality pass on the whole world.
Your rank on paper, two races at once, and a stack of fixes from your reports.
The map pins now sit on the places the map draws.
Relationship Updates + Pets + THANKS FOR 2 MILLION TURNS!
